messages.subject: Re: CONSTRAIN Parameters
parts:
You didn't pass your character model to mirt, and instead left it as a standard 1 factor specification (model = 1). Just add model=mirt.mod.nar to your mirt() call and it should work fine. HTH.

Phil


On Mon, Mar 8, 2021 at 6:38 PM Lingyue Li <ling...@illinois.edu> wrote:
Hi Phil,

I had a problem when I was trying to constrain the tau parameters (t1) to be equal in the model. Though I specified the constrain, I still got different tau parameters. Please see my code below:

mirt.mod.narc <- "F1 = N1-N52
                  PRIOR = (N1-N52,b1,norm,0,1),(N1-N52,a1,lnorm,0.2,0.5)
                  CONSTRAIN = (N1-N52,t1)"

mirt_NARC <- mirt::mirt(data = NARC_dich-1,model = 1,itemtype = "ggum")

mirt.para.narc1 <- mirt::coef(mirt_NARC,simplify=T)


Do you know what's wrong with the code? Thank you!

Lingyue
